name: Buipui Full-System AI-Assisted Optimised Protocol
scope: All Buipui system families, engines, native cores, federation layers, ML systems, digital twins, evidence systems and future computational/quantum research engines.
control_principle: Observe -> map -> model -> intersect -> decompile -> defragment -> anchor -> recompile -> verify -> learn -> optimise -> promote.

crashing_referees.meaning: Federated systems are deliberately brought into controlled intersection/collision states so the referee layer can identify semantic, interface, dependency, resource and behavioural conflicts.
crashing_referees.not_literal: This does not mean uncontrolled production crashes.

decompilation.meaning: After a collision or fault state, the affected executable/source relationship is decomposed into semantic units and mapped geometry so the system can inspect what actually happened.
decompilation.purpose: Recover structure, dependencies, behaviour and provenance before defragmentation.

defrag_protocol.meaning: Reorganise decomposed code/system fragments into coherent semantic paths while retaining every fragment's provenance and relationship to the original state.
defrag_protocol.blockchain_anchor: The defragmentation event, source/content hashes, geometry snapshot, parent state, resulting state and evidence references are anchored to the provenance chain.
defrag_protocol.rule: Blockchain anchors the transformation record; it is not the executable storage layer.

code_anchor_metadata.meaning: Every executable or mapped code unit receives machine-readable metadata linking implementation identity to geometry node, semantic contract, dependency graph, revision, evidence and provenance.

recompile_after.meaning: Recompilation occurs only after decompilation, mapping, defragmentation and semantic reconciliation have produced a candidate clean path.

multidimensional_path_logging.purpose: Every transformation path is retained so the AI can compare the original, faulted, decomposed, defragmented, recompiled and verified states.
multidimensional_path_logging.principle: The path is evidence, not discarded intermediate history.

canonical_representation.rule: Code remains executable implementation; computational geometry is the canonical machine-readable representation for system relationships, behaviour, state transitions and optimisation.
canonical_representation.geometry_model: Represent systems as multidimensional computational graphs/hypergraphs whose nodes and edges encode code units, interfaces, capabilities, dependencies, states, behaviour, resources, evidence and provenance.
canonical_representation.negative_space: Absent, blocked, unavailable, forbidden, quarantined and unverified paths are first-class geometry states.
canonical_representation.code_mapping: Every mapped code element resolves to a semantic geometry node and typed relationship edges.

shared_engine_model.principle: All ML systems share the Buipui Intelligence core engine and scale through modular engines, datasets, geometry maps and platform adapters.

quantum_federation_control.role: Controlled multi-system state exploration and transformation protocol.

referee.role: Neutral semantic/control layer that compares intersecting system states and records conflicts.

collision_protocol.production_rule: No destructive collision is permitted against an authoritative build.

defragmentation_protocol.trigger: Verified collision/fault evidence requiring decomposition or restructuring.
defragmentation_protocol.deletion_rule: No fragment is deleted solely because it appears redundant; it is retained, classified and provenance-linked until an evidence-backed promotion decision.

evidence_and_blockchain.role: Integrity and provenance anchor for every significant geometry transformation.
evidence_and_blockchain.rule: The blockchain anchor preserves transformation integrity; the full evidence and executable artifacts remain in the appropriate evidence/repository systems.

optimisation_protocol.constraint: Optimisation cannot override functional correctness, safety gates or provenance.

machine_readable_principles: Code is executable; geometry is the canonical relationship model.
Bring systems into controlled intersections to reveal conflicts.
Defragment according to semantic geometry, not arbitrary source order.
Anchor code identity and transformation metadata to provenance.
Recompile only from an explicitly mapped candidate state.
Learn from behaviour and evidence, not source assumptions alone.
All ML systems share the Buipui Intelligence core engine.
Native functionality is preferred when it satisfies the contract.
Quantum models remain computational/research abstractions unless physical evidence establishes otherwise.
Clean, failed, experimental and archived paths remain separately traceable.
Blockchain anchors provenance but does not replace the evidence store.
No promotion occurs without reproducible evidence.
